snapshots.note: v1 draft from description: 20 fine options mapped to 18 classes

v2: batch-1 rules H1-H6 (thank appreciation, logical from partner's stated view, amount-choice=donation-info, own past experience=personal-story, website=credibility, post-commit reassurance=other, direct plea=proposition)

v4: batch-2 rules H8-H12 (other covers persuader small talk / other ways to help; praise vs thank; personal-story needs narrative; ask-amount only partner's own amount) as 3-member wording-variant ensemble

v5 ensemble: batch-3 rules H13-H19 (personal-inquiry = partner's own charity involvement; persuader matching offer = self-modeling; org matching partnerships = credibility; endorsement of org's work = credibility vs bare valuation = other; late pleasantries = other)

v6 ensemble: batch-4 rules H20-H22 (recalled partner statement takes class of the appeal it sets up; org's own activities/impact = credibility vs partner's donation effect = logical; reply arguing money well used = logical) + volunteering offer = other, narrower off-task

v7 final ensemble: batch-5 rules H23 (question about raising money via others = task-inq), H25 (fragment completing own previous message takes its class), H26 (answering donation-mechanics question = donation-info); H24 (FITD vs logical) and H27 rewording dropped after tests. 42/50 on uncertainty-sampled labels.
